summary: Allow TieringOffloadingSpec with a filesystem tier under expandable_segments without enable_cumem_allocator
compatibility: No user action required. Tiers that do not declare host-only I/O (p2p, obj, out-of-tree) stay rejected under expandable_segments as before.
details: SecondaryTierManager.retains_gpu_page_registrations (default True) lets a tier declare that it only touches the host primary region.
The fs tier declares False, so TieringOffloadingSpec with fs tiers counts as VMM-safe.
